ui_bugs.issue: 'Next up' chip never renders. Parent computes nextUpId correctly (line 80-92) but line 134 instantiates <BadgeCard key={b.id} badge={b} index={i} /> WITHOUT passing isNextUp. BadgeCard declares isNextUp?: boolean prop (line 141) and only renders the [data-testid=badge-<id>-next-up] chip when isNextUp is truthy (line 211). Result: 0 next-up chips in DOM, failing the acceptance criterion 'exactly one unearned badge shows the Next up chip'. Fix: change line 134 to <BadgeCard key={b.id} badge={b} index={i} isNextUp={b.id === nextUpId} />.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid=testimonial-next] did not increment the counter (stayed at 5/10 after two next-clicks) although [data-testid=testimonial-prev] correctly went 5→4 (Marcus Holt). Likely the right-side floating 'Carte de Progression' quick-nav panel (visible in screenshots at ~x=1425 top-right of viewport) overlaps the right-hand chevron button on desktop viewports, intercepting the click; force=True on Playwright bypasses actionability checks but the DOM event still targets the topmost element. Recommend z-index or right-padding fix so the next-arrow is not occluded by the progress-card side rail. NOTE: dots (testimonial-dot-*) and prev arrow are unaffected because they sit to the left of the overlay.

critical_code_review_comments: HomeTrophyCase.tsx: nextUpId is computed with a useMemo (correct) but never threaded down to the child — a classic 'declared-but-not-wired' bug. This suggests the acceptance criterion was never manually verified during implementation. Adding a snapshot test that asserts one and only one [data-testid$=-next-up] appears when there is any unearned badge would prevent regressions.
HomeSocialProof.tsx goTo() clears the auto-cycle timer but never restarts it — after the first manual click, the carousel stops auto-cycling forever until page reload. Minor UX debt.
HomeChecklist.tsx correctly conditions the ETA chip on incomplete items only (4/5 items show ~2 min in observed data), and the pulsing 'Start here' chip fires on the first incomplete item — good.

Backend /api/home/today-pulse correctly upserts user_login_days by day (idempotent within the same UTC day) and computes streak by walking descending days — confirmed streak stays at 1 across two consecutive same-day calls.

rca_of_the_issue: TROPHY 'NEXT UP' MISSING — Root cause: HomeTrophyCase.tsx computes `const nextUpId = React.useMemo(...)` at lines 80-92 (correct logic — picks unearned badge with highest progress/threshold ratio) but never threads it into the child. Line 134 renders `<BadgeCard key={b.id} badge={b} index={i} />` — the `isNextUp` prop declared on line 141 (`function BadgeCard({ badge: b, index, isNextUp })`) is undefined for every card, so the conditional at line 211 (`) : isNextUp ? (...next-up chip...) : (...lock icon...)`) always falls through to the lock icon branch. Reproduction: log in as free user, scroll to trophy-case-section, query DOM for `[data-testid$=-next-up]` — returns 0 nodes. Mitigation: `<BadgeCard key={b.id} badge={b} index={i} isNextUp={b.id === nextUpId} />`. Verify: exactly one chip renders on the badge with id equal to nextUpId (currently 'champion' at 1/5). TESTIMONIAL-NEXT NOT ADVANCING — Root cause hypothesis: the persistent right-side 'Carte de Progression' quick-nav rail (fixed-position side card visible in all desktop screenshots at approximately x≈1425 top-right of viewport) sits above the right chevron button of the testimonial carousel at 1920px viewport, capturing the click. Prev arrow (left side) is unaffected because it is not under the overlay; dots (center-bottom) also work. Recommend adjusting the overlay's right-margin or z-index / pointer-events on the specific area of overlap.
